integrity.claim_scope: Exact joint Laplace transform of completion time, local time, and upper residence time for a Poisson-reset Brownian first-passage model; conditional subordinator law and strict monotone correlation.
integrity.proof_status: Analytical matched-interface Feynman–Kac proof and Lévy-measure representation.
scientific_limitations: No arbitrary diffusion, drift, renewal reset, or general initial-state extension.
Known marginal transforms and known reflected-process inverse-local-time kernel are not claimed as new.
Independent publication-priority verification has not been performed.

title: Joint first-passage exposure law for Brownian diffusion with Poisson resetting
